description: Connect your Do Workout account to ChatGPT to review your training, understand your progress, check your schedule and programs, and get practical suggestions based on your workout history. You can also create program change proposals for review in Do Workout. Changes are applied only after you explicitly accept them.

defaultPrompt: How is my training going this week?
Review my current training program and suggest one practical improvement.
What should I train next based on my current program and progress?
